note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English: the alate is unknown and only the soldier is described, with no description of the worker; measurements are taken from the text; synonymy citations, distribution and figure numbers are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head brownish yellow to yellowish brown; antennae brownish yellow; anteclypeus, labrum, pronotum, legs and abdomen yellow; mandibles reddish brown, brownish yellow at the base. Head and pronotum sparsely hairy. Head capsule subrectangular-oval, longer than wide (length to mandibular base 1.19–1.40, maximum width 1.06–1.21 mm); sides weakly convex, slightly narrowing anteriorly (width at mandibular base 0.74–0.85 mm); posterior margin weakly convex. Fontanelle situated anteriorly; frontal prominence not projecting, with slightly more hairs than the rest of the head. Compound eyes and ocelli absent. Antennae 14-segmented; segment 2 longer than segment 3; segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus bilobed. Labrum broad, ligulate, wider than long. Mandibles stout at the base, abruptly narrowing and strongly incurved anteriorly (length 0.72–0.82 mm); each with one distinct, posteriorly directed tooth situated at the middle. Postmentum club-shaped; widest at the anterior third, narrowest at the narrow waist near the posterior margin (length 0.63–0.82, maximum width 0.31–0.41 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin with an indistinct emargination, posterior margin nearly straight (length 0.30–0.36, maximum width 0.62–0.72 mm). Tibial spurs 3:2:2; tarsus 4-segmented.
